subject: Hosted API renewal & rate review — retention credit request
messages:
From: Claire Hammond <claire@alliedhealth.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-11-26T17:05:00-05:00
Subject: Renewal and usage increase — request for rate review

Sergio,

Thanks again for the product walkthrough yesterday — the Hosted API latency improvements have been noticeable in our staging tests. We're preparing our Q1 budget and wanted to see if Redwood can offer a deeper committed-rate for a renewal — we're looking at a 12-month renewal with a 3x increase in committed monthly tokens compared to our current plan.

Quick background: current monthly committed spend ~ $45k; projected (after ramp) monthly committed spend ~ $135k. We'd like to lock a 12-month agreement if we can get a meaningful unit-cost reduction — the economics we'd need to proceed fast are in the ~25–30% range.

If you can route this to your commercial team/leadership for review, that would be great. Timeline: we need a term sheet by EoD next Tuesday so our procurement can start review.

Attached: (we've shared an internal usage summary but will send formal numbers if helpful)

Appreciate the help — happy to jump on a call.

—Claire
Claire Hammond
VP Product, AlliedHealth Systems
claire@alliedhealth.com
+1 415 555 0143

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-11-26T18:12:00-05:00
Subject: Fwd: Renewal and usage increase — request for rate review

Ben / Mina / David — forwarding Claire's ask from AlliedHealth. TL;DR: customer is prepared to commit to a 12-month renewal and roughly 3x committed monthly spend if we can hit ~25–30% off our standard Hosted API published usage rates. They want a term sheet by next Tues.

Why I recommend escalation: AlliedHealth is strategic in payer integrations and is previewing a feature that will materially increase token volumes for several other prospects; retention risk is real if we don't lock attractive economics. They are currently in production and have full telemetry in our console.

Proposal for consideration: authorize a one-year, committed-volume contract with a 25% unit price concession off standard Hosted API usage rates, conditional on:
- 12-month minimum term
- Minimum committed spend of $1.08M total ($90k/mo equivalent for first 12 months, phased ramp to $135k/mo)
- Standard data residency + SOC2 terms (no additional waivers)
- Deal desk sign-off on payment schedule (upfront quarters acceptable)

Attachments: usage_report_q1-q3.csv, proposed_term_sheet.pdf (draft)

Ask: Ben — can you route to Marcus for exec signoff? Mina — deal desk assessment and confirm legal/finance guardrails ok. David — is the revenue recognition pattern acceptable if we offer the concession?

Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-11-26T20:03:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal and usage increase — request for rate review

Sergio — thanks for the write up. Two quick asks before I flag Marcus:  
1) Margin impact: what's expected blended gross margin after the proposed 25% concession at the committed volumes (David, can you quantify?).
2) Early-termination: if they fail to ramp to the 3x volumes, do we step them down to a higher rate or enforce make-whole? We should be explicit in the term sheet.

If financials look acceptable and Mina confirms no unusual legal exposure, I will request Marcus' approval for a one-time commercial concession. Please include a clean clause for performance-based re-pricing and a minimum guaranteed spend.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Enterprise Sales

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-11-27T11:40:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal and usage increase — request for rate review

All — reviewed the draft term sheet and the usage exhibit that Sergio attached. Key risk notes:
- Legal: no unusual indemnities; standard T&Cs ok. We should include a clear performance milestone schedule (months 1–3 ramp targets) and a re-pricing fallback if they miss the thresholds.
- Finance: recommend a minimum total committed ARR of $1.08M (matches Sergio) before we apply the full 25% concession. If they commit to $900k–$1.08M, we could stagger discount (20% for $900k, 25% for $1.08M+).
- Billing: prefer quarterly advance invoicing for first 2 quarters if customer is in new billing terms.

Attached: deal_summary.xlsx with scenario margin impact.

If Ben is comfortable, please route to Marcus for final sign-off. I'll prepare the clause for ramp-based re-price.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Deal Desk Manager

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-11-28T09:22:00-08:00
Subject: Approval: conditional concession for AlliedHealth (25% off hosted usage)

Ben / Sergio / Mina — I've reviewed the ask and the deal summary. Approved to offer a 25% unit price concession on Hosted API usage for a 12-month committed agreement subject to the following conditions (must be met in executed contract):
1) Minimum total committed spend of $1.08M across 12 months (we will accept staged ramp but commitment must be contracted)
2) Quarterly advance billing for first two quarters or a 25% upfront payment (finance to confirm acceptable option)
3) Performance milestones (months 1–3 ramp schedule) with explicit re-pricing triggers if they miss thresholds (Mina to insert standard language)
4) No additional legal waivers beyond SOC2 & standard data residency clauses
5) Signed DocuSign copy and HubSpot deal stage moved to "Closed - Concession" before provisioning special pricing

Mina — please prepare the final clause set and coordinate with Legal and Finance to get the DocuSign to the customer. Ben / Sergio — work with the customer to finalize the term sheet and get commitment by next Tuesday.

Approver: Marcus Lin
Head of Revenue, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com
